condition.name: Infernal
condition.blurb: The ground still burns from every war fought over it. The heat comes up through boots and armour alike, and nobody stands in it for long without paying.
condition.advice: Everyone burns a little every moment of a fight, and armour does not stop it. End fights fast and bring healing that keeps up.

vow.name: An Unpaid Debt
vow.text: Bears an old debt to a family in the Ninefold Vale that no coin, favour, or season will ever settle.

vow.name: When the Horn Goes
vow.text: Swore they would never again be in a guild that heard the horn and stayed by its fire.

vow.name: Blooded at the Front
vow.text: Means to be the one the songs are about when the coalition marches home.

vow.name: Coin Sent Home
vow.text: Sends every coin they can spare back to a family that does not know their face any more.

vow.name: Someone to Come Home To
vow.text: Keeps their heart guarded, but half-means to find one person worth coming back for.

vow.name: First Prize
vow.text: Means to win a Gathering outright, and hear the whole realm say their name.

vow.name: Nothing Lost to Want of Mending
vow.text: Swore to put back more than the dark could take, and keeps the count to prove it.

vow.name: Down
vow.text: Means to go down the old stair, and to be standing on a floor of it that no one in this guild has stood on.

vow.name: A Head for the Wall
vow.text: Means to bring down a beast worth a name out of the Ninefold Vale, and hang its head where the whole guild can see.

vow.name: What the Stair Took
vow.text: Lost someone to the old stair, and does not intend for the Deep to keep both of them.

vow.name: The Crown, Once
vow.text: Means to stand in a guild crowned champion of the realm, just once.

vow.name: A Hall of Their Own
vow.text: Means to run a guild before the end, and to be the one whose name is over the door.

vow.name: A Head for the Wall
vow.text: Means to bring down a beast worth a name out of the Elderwood, and hang its head where the whole guild can see.

vow.name: Against the Fire
vow.text: Vowed to stand for the Ironhold Deeps the next time the fire comes.

vow.name: A Promise Unspoken
vow.text: Made a promise at The Skyshrine they have told no one, and have not broken yet.

vow.name: The Last of the Blood
vow.text: Swore at a graveside to be the last of their blood the dark takes early.

vow.name: One Last Time
vow.text: Means to stand before The Mootstone once more before the end.

vow.name: Something They Did
vow.text: Means to go back to the Ashen Marches and answer for something they did there.

vow.name: A Reckoning
vow.text: Keeps a cold, private reckoning with the guild that wronged them, and means to outlast them.

vow.name: The Proof
vow.text: Means to be the proof that a kindred written off can rise.

vow.name: Down
vow.text: Means to go down the old stair, and to be standing on a floor of it that no one in this guild has stood on.

vow.name: One Last Time
vow.text: Means to stand before The First Deep once more before the end.

vow.name: By the Hundred
vow.text: Was told as a recruit that the dark sends its soldiers by the hundred, and decided to take that as a number to beat.

vow.name: Someone to Come Home To
vow.text: Keeps their heart guarded, but half-means to find one person worth coming back for.

vow.name: The Quiet War
vow.text: Swore off a habit that once cost them everything, and fights it every quiet day.

vow.name: Among the Great Houses
vow.text: Means to see their kin counted among the great houses again, not pitied.

vow.name: A Head for the Wall
vow.text: Means to bring down a beast worth a name out of the Pale Reach, and hang its head where the whole guild can see.

vow.name: How Far It Goes
vow.text: Does not care what is at the bottom of the Deep so much as whether anyone alive can say how far down it is.

vow.name: A Reckoning
vow.text: Keeps a cold, private reckoning with the guild that wronged them, and means to outlast them.

vow.name: First to Be Struck
vow.text: Swore that every blow meant for the party would find them first, and keeps the count.

vow.name: A Grave to Answer
vow.text: Left someone in the ground in the Ashen Marches, and will not have it be for nothing.

vow.name: The Last of the Blood
vow.text: Swore at a graveside to be the last of their blood the dark takes early.

vow.name: Unfinished Business
vow.text: Means to go home to the Ashen Marches one day, and settle what was left unsettled there.

jobBoard.title: Raise the Shrine between watches
jobBoard.blurb: Stand a watch on the wall and work the Shrine in the hours between. Whoever goes works, and does not fight.

jobBoard.title: Haul ash mortar for the Shrine
jobBoard.blurb: What burned in the last war is mortar for the Shrine. It has to be carried in from the burn, and the burn is not empty.

jobBoard.title: A Rumour out of The Riven Peaks
jobBoard.blurb: Someone came back from The Skyshrine with something. Most of them came back with nothing.

jobBoard.title: A Price on Karrog the Gorged
jobBoard.blurb: A hunt, plainly put: find Karrog the Gorged, end it, come back. The Riven Peaks is not asking for anything else.

jobBoard.title: The Long Road into The Elderwood
jobBoard.blurb: A survey beyond The Mootstone. Long, cold, thankless, and the sort of thing that makes a name.
